# Independent audit: three-fiber effective-profile gluing obstruction


`candidate 907b6bf347e73ada`.

ordinary effective-three-cap coefficient.

The paired-tail identity follows from T_L(-t)=2L-T_L(t). Its difference
D_L is odd in its center variable and has the stated nonnegative
indicator derivative. In the lower-bound second regime r>l+c, the two
indicator intervals have a gap exceeding 2c, so a length-2c integration
interval meets at most one and its contribution is at most2c. This
proves both bounds for every slope and every symmetric threshold pair.

Central symmetry of the continuous product factor pairs all oblique
thresholds exactly. A negative x coefficient uses the complementary
paired bounds, and zero x coefficient uses an actually symmetric
projected measure with closed-boundary mass retained. Thus the lower
bound is for all ambient halfspaces at a point in the middle fiber.

The positive margin identity 2L0+L++L-=0 proves the three original caps
cover all space. Endpoint saturation and the linear middle interval
section prove their exact equal budgets, including the nonzero w-tilt
that gives continuous normal rank2. Their upper certificate and the
preceding lower bound establish true activity, not only an equal-cap
cover. The no-heavy condition is exactly c<l/2.

The rational table gives M=156/20 and B=69/20, hence
M-(9/4)B=(624-621)/80=3/80, depth69/156=23/52, and
(3B-M)/B=(207-156)/69=17/23. The listed tilt eps=1/2 on the unit-width
cube has maximum magnitude1/4, so A=2 exceeds l+c+1/4=17/10.
The ordinary .75 overlap coefficient is therefore strictly violated
with all the stated genuine geometry. Nevertheless23/52 is larger
than Gamma_d/2 for every d>=2, as the source explicitly records.
